summary: חוּט denotes a thread or cord. Abram names a single thread as an example of how little he would refuse to take from the king of Sodom.

senses.definition: A strand of material used as thread or cord.

evidence.note: Abram begins his refusal with “from a thread to a sandal strap,” naming even the smallest things the king owns.
Samson snaps the new ropes off his arms as easily as a thread.

words.summary: A strand such as the thread Abram pairs with a sandal strap.

note: Root (2026-11-21): Kept under the hollow root חוט: Arabic خَاطَ "sew" and خَيْطٌ "thread" (Lane root خيط, p. 831) are the cognate, with Hebrew ḥ for older ḫ; Hebrew has no verb.
